services.name: Educational Programs and Resources
services.desc: Discover what’s on at the Ottawa Art Gallery and visit our exhibitions, events, and talks. Discover the collections, exhibitions and programs available at the Ottawa Art Gallery. Explore OAG’s virtual school tours, guided in-person school tours and workshops, and our unique and engaging teacher’s resources and modules for grades K-12. School programs for grades K-12 at OAG are both fun and educational. Guided tours and workshops are designed with the Ontario and Quebec curricula in mind, and tailored to suit the needs and interests of each group. Our passionate and skillful guides strive to create a unique and memorable experience that will broaden students’ perspectives on the world
